verdict.rationale: Summer Engine's own marketing says it is a full engine that builds 3D games, so it does ship a 3D renderer. Nothing in the evidence describes that renderer's features, so its depth is entirely unproven and this is only a glancing mention. Missing for 10: documented PBR materials, global illumination or baked lighting, a shadow system, a post-processing stack, any statement that the renderer is production-grade, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, the engine ships a modern production 3D renderer — PBR materials, global illumination or baked lighting, shadows, post-processing

citations.quote: Make real 2D and 3D games with Summer Engine that you can launch on Summer Games, Steam, iOS or Android.
Describe the game you want and Summer builds it with you in a full engine: 2D and 3D, physics, animation and real gameplay.
